answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the karst of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
